name: Citizenship by Descent and Ethnic-Somali Declaration

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant's father is a Somali citizen -- citizenship acquired automatically by operation of law. The located text does not state an equivalent automatic provision for a Somali mother and a non-Somali father.

A Somali (by ethnicity/community, not already a citizen by the paternal-descent rule) residing in Somali territory or abroad who declares willingness to renounce any foreign nationality becomes a Somali citizen automatically. This provision reads as intended for ethnic Somalis whose ancestral homeland spans neighbouring states (e.g. Ethiopia's Somali Region/Ogaden, northern Kenya) rather than for unrelated foreign nationals.
requirements.fix_path: Submit a declaration of willingness to renounce any foreign nationality.

evidence_required.document: Father's proof of Somali citizenship (paternal-descent track)
Declaration of willingness to renounce foreign nationality (ethnic-Somali track)

sources.title: Citizenship Rights in Africa Initiative -- Somali Citizenship Law No. 28 of 22 December 1962, Article 2(a): citizenship by operation of law for a person whose father is a Somali citizen; Article 2(b): a Somali residing in Somali territory or abroad who declares willingness to renounce foreign nationality status becomes a citizen automatically

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Somalia). STATUS: DRAFT -- same tier-2-only sourcing limitation as this dataset's other Somalia citizenship files. GENDERED GAP, DISCLOSED PRECISELY: the located text of Article 2(a) ties automatic descent citizenship to a SOMALI FATHER; no equivalent automatic provision transmitting citizenship through a Somali mother (where the father is not Somali) was located -- this build could not confirm whether such a child is entirely excluded or falls back to the reduced-residence naturalization track in so_citizenship_naturalisation.json's Article 5 provision (2 years' residence for the child of a Somali mother), which would imply the child of a Somali mother is NOT automatically a citizen and must actively reside and apply. This is flagged as the single most consequential open question in this build -- Somalia's descent-citizenship gender asymmetry appears structurally similar to Sudan's pre-2006 rule, but unlike Sudan, no source located here confirms Somalia has ever amended it. DISTINCTIVE STRUCTURAL FEATURE NOT SEEN ELSEWHERE IN THIS DATASET: Article 2(b)'s ethnic-Somali declaration route reads as a mechanism for the many ethnic Somalis living across Ethiopia's Somali Region, northern Kenya, and Djibouti (a legacy of colonial-era border-drawing splitting the Somali-inhabited Horn of Africa) to formalize Somali citizenship by declaration alone, without the residence/conduct requirements of ordinary naturalization -- modeled here as its own requirement_group since it operates on an entirely different logic (ancestral/ethnic identity) than the paternal-descent track.
